title: cyclosorus rigidus
intro: Cyclosorus rigidus, commonly known as Rigid Leptosporangiate Fern, is a type of plant belonging to the family Thelypteridaceae. It is native to various parts of the world, including Asia, Australia, and parts of North America. The health benefits of Cyclosorus rigidus include its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate oxidative stress, thanks to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds found in its leaves and roots.
